project.title: Seed pitch (redesign test)
project.goal: Get seed investors to book a follow-up call: hook with the problem, show traction (200 paying teams), end with the 1.5M ask and a clear call to action.

1_key_moments.label: Problem Hook
1_key_moments.why: Clearly states the founder pain point of rehearsing without feedback and freezing in front of investors.

1_key_moments.label: Solution & Product
1_key_moments.why: Introduces PitchStudio and explains how it coaches live and auto-edits a 30-second pitch video.

1_key_moments.label: Traction Proof
1_key_moments.why: Delivers the key metric of 200 paying startup teams raising twice as fast.

1_key_moments.label: The Ask & CTA
1_key_moments.why: States the $1.5M seed round ask and ends with a direct call to action to book a demo call this week.

changes: Removed opening filler and mid-pitch stumble for a clean 29s runtime
Opened immediately on the founder pain point hook
Cropped to 9:16 vertical format centering the presenter
Added burned-in captions and bold top banners for traction and $1.5M ask
rationale: Cut opening hesitation and jump straight to the problem hook at 6.4s.
Trim redundant phrase at 13.6s to keep pacing tight under 30 seconds.
Include product explanation from 15.8s to 25.0s, cutting the stumble after.
Start traction segment at 29.0s to capture 'Since launch, 200 startup teams'.
Close with the $1.5M seed ask and call to action from 35.0s to 42.6s.
Center-crop 16:9 to 9:16 and burn bold captions with top headline overlays.

3_critic_v1.verdict: Not publishable: outtake caption and truncated ending
3_critic_v1.summary: The pitch hits all key brief points with good pacing, but caption errors, a pronunciation glitch, and a clipped ending prevent publishing.
blockers: Outtake text 'go back' left in captions

issues.problem: Audio and captions cut off after 'with us this'
issues.fix: Extend clip by 1 second so 'this week' finishes.
Replace stray outtake text with 'automatically.' in captions.

issues.problem: Word 'feedback' is spoken but missing from captions
issues.fix: Add 'feedback.' to the caption block at 0:04.

issues.problem: Caption says 'We build pitch studio' instead of 'built'
issues.fix: Change caption text to 'We built Pitch Studio.'

5_critic_v2.verdict: Strong structure, but tight cuts clip words
5_critic_v2.summary: The pitch hits every goal in 29 seconds with zero filler, but aggressive cuts clip the ends of words at two transitions.
blockers: Bottom captions are small rather than bold

issues.problem: Cut clips the final syllable of 'automatically'.
issues.fix: Extend outgoing clip by 150-200ms before cutting to traction.

issues.problem: Word 'investors' is slightly clipped before the next cut.
issues.fix: Add 100ms tail padding to the first clip.

issues.problem: Caption paraphrases spoken audio, dropping 'while you rehearse'.
issues.fix: Match captions verbatim to spoken words for smoother reading.

issues.problem: Bottom subtitle bar is small for a 'bold captions' brief.
issues.fix: Increase subtitle font size and weight for mobile viewing.
